note: Flat Taxonomy forces a vocabulary to be flat (non-hierarchical). It adds a 'Flat taxonomy' checkbox to the vocabulary form; the flag is stored as a third-party setting flat_taxonomy.flat (value 1 = flat) on the taxonomy.vocabulary.<id> config entity (schema taxonomy.vocabulary.*.third_party.flat_taxonomy; constants FlatConstants::FLAT_TAXONOMY_FLAT=1 / NORMAL=0). No configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no plugins; runs on core Taxonomy. When flat: term-form parent hidden+validated, 'Add child' op removed, overview drag-drop nesting stripped, hook_taxonomy_term_presave forces parent=0. Ticking the box calls the flat_taxonomy.taxonomy_flattener service (Flattener::flatten()) which un-nests existing terms. Medium cases read back which namespaced vocabulary is flat; hard cases flag a vocabulary flat and flatten an existing nested vocabulary, verified against live config / term parents.

evals.prompt: How do I make a specific taxonomy vocabulary flat (non-hierarchical) with the flat_taxonomy module, and where is that choice stored?
evals.expected_output: On the vocabulary add/edit form tick the 'Flat taxonomy' checkbox and save. It is stored as a third-party setting on the vocabulary config entity: taxonomy.vocabulary.<id> -> third_party_settings.flat_taxonomy.flat = 1 (1 = flat).

evals.prompt: Once a vocabulary is marked flat by flat_taxonomy, what does the module do to stop editors creating nested terms?
evals.expected_output: It hides the parent field on the term add/edit form (and validates that no parent is submitted), removes the 'Add child' term operation, strips the depth/parent drag-and-drop from the term overview, and hook_taxonomy_term_presave resets parent to 0 (with a warning) if a term is saved with a parent programmatically.

evals.prompt: If I turn on flat_taxonomy for a vocabulary that already has nested terms, what happens to the existing hierarchy, and which service does it?
evals.expected_output: Ticking the Flat checkbox immediately flattens existing terms (moves them to the root) via the flat_taxonomy.taxonomy_flattener service (Flattener::flatten()), which recursively sets each term's parent to 0 while preserving order via weights.

evals.prompt: On this site, one taxonomy vocabulary has been forced flat with flat_taxonomy. Inspect the live vocabulary configuration and give the machine name (vid) of that flat vocabulary.
evals.expected_output: The vocabulary flattax_known is flat: taxonomy.vocabulary.flattax_known -> third_party_settings.flat_taxonomy.flat = 1.

evals.prompt: Is the vocabulary 'flattax_known' on this site configured as a flat taxonomy? Inspect its live configuration and report the flat_taxonomy setting value.
evals.expected_output: Yes: taxonomy.vocabulary.flattax_known has third_party_settings.flat_taxonomy.flat = 1, so it is flat.

evals.prompt: This site has a taxonomy vocabulary with the machine name 'flattax_task' that is currently a normal (hierarchical) vocabulary. Using flat_taxonomy, force this vocabulary to be flat so editors can no longer nest its terms. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: taxonomy.vocabulary.flattax_task has third_party_settings.flat_taxonomy.flat = 1. Set it via the 'Flat taxonomy' checkbox on the vocabulary form, or $vocab->setThirdPartySetting('flat_taxonomy','flat',1)->save().

evals.prompt: The vocabulary 'flattax_tree' on this site currently has nested terms (a child term under a parent term). Using flat_taxonomy, make this vocabulary flat and flatten it so none of its terms have a parent anymore. Apply the change to the live site (keep the terms, just remove the nesting).
evals.expected_output: After flattening, no term in flattax_tree has a non-zero parent. Set the vocabulary flat (third_party_settings.flat_taxonomy.flat=1) and run the flat_taxonomy.taxonomy_flattener service's flatten() on it (ticking the Flat checkbox on the vocabulary form does both automatically).
